column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the audio/media properties record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing DeviceIdentity(DevRegistry), linking these audio/media specs to a device.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Performance(PerfRegistry), associating audio/media data with performance metrics.
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring sound output level in decibels from the device.
A VARCHAR(30) describing the sound signature (e.g., Silent, Thocky, Clicky, Linear).
A SMALLINT for how many dB of noise isolation the device provides.
A NUMERIC(4,1) capturing audio latency (in ms) from signal to output.
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring microphone sensitivity in dB (e.g., dBV).
A VARCHAR(50) specifying the microphone frequency response range (e.g., 20Hz–20kHz).
A SMALLINT indicating the speaker or driver impedance in ohms.
A SMALLINT specifying speaker sensitivity in decibels (dB SPL @ 1kHz).
A NUMERIC(3,2) for total harmonic distortion (THD) as a percentage.
A VARCHAR(50) describing the device’s frequency response specification (e.g., 20Hz–20kHz).
A SMALLINT measuring the diameter (in mm) of the speaker or audio driver.
A VARCHAR(30) naming any surround sound technology (e.g., Stereo, 5.1, 7.1).
A SMALLINT counting available EQ profiles or presets.
A BOOLEAN indicating if mic monitoring (sidetone) is supported.
An enum (NoiseCanc_enum) denoting the noise cancellation type (None, Passive, Active).
A VARCHAR(35) referencing Bluetooth version (e.g., 4.0, 5.0, 5.1, 5.2) if applicable.
A SMALLINT specifying typical Bluetooth range in meters.
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring Bluetooth audio latency (in ms).
A BOOLEAN stating whether the device can connect to multiple endpoints simultaneously.
A SMALLINT specifying how many minutes pass before the device goes into auto-sleep mode.
A NUMERIC(5,1) representing how many milliseconds it takes for the device to wake from sleep.
